0022600204.text: The Cleveland Cavaliers (5-5, 7th in the East and 1.5 games behind for 2nd in the Central) visit the Charlotte Hornets (3-7, 10th in the East) on a one-game losing streak, with a 1-3 road record so far. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Cleveland won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 118-113 win in Charlotte on February 20, 2026. Cleveland is missing Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and Sam Merrill (elbow), while Charlotte is without Brandon Miller (groin soreness), Dennis Schroder (hamstring strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring strain), and Moussa Diabate (quadriceps).
